fusions.name: Stoop From the Spire
fusions.desc: Drops a stone from height onto a target up to 7 tiles away that deals 20 damage, rising to 1.8 times that at full reach. Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Swallow's Pellets
fusions.desc: Flings 3 mud pellets at once in a spread, and each deals 2 damage. Your movement speed rises 12% for 2 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Mud-Cup Nest
fusions.desc: Surrounds you with a shield that absorbs the next 18 damage, up to 4 blows, for 6 seconds. Your movement speed rises 15% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Beakful of Mud
fusions.desc: Every few paces you cover, you gain a shield worth 8% of your maximum health for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
